Document: - 1. Deliberately attacking dangerous creatures with improvised tools (crowbar, screwdriver, canister, hatchet, etc.) is a clear violation of this rule. A reasonable response to such a threat is to run away or at least observe it from a distance. If such a creature attacks you and escape is impossible, you may use whatever is at hand to defend yourself. - 2. Armed bombs are clearly not something ordinary crew members should interact with; the reasonable response upon seeing one is to flee. Security officers, as the station's first line of defense, or engineers and scientists, as technical specialists, should disarm bombs, and only while using blast-resistant equipment. Ordinary crew members or personnel without protective equipment may attempt to disarm a bomb only when it poses a direct threat to their life and escape is impossible.
